hero.title: Short-Term Device Leasing
hero.subtitle: Flexible solutions for your dynamic workforce

intro.paragraph1: In today's dynamic workforce environment, businesses are increasingly seeking flexible solutions to provide the latest smartphones to non-permanent employees, without the burden of full device ownership costs.
intro.paragraph2: The Short-Term Device Leasing Program from Evergreen Wireless offers an innovative alternative, allowing businesses to lease CPO Device Bundles for a fixed term providing the ultimate financial flexibility.

fixedCosts.title: Fixed Monthly Costs
fixedCosts.description: Predictable monthly expenses starting from $50.00 per month

flexibility.title: Flexible Terms
flexibility.description: Leasing terms from 6-months to suit your business needs

noUpfront.title: No Upfront Costs
noUpfront.description: Eliminate upfront costs while accessing the latest technology

download.title: Device Leasing Program
download.description: Download our comprehensive guide to learn more about our short-term device leasing program and how it can benefit your organization.

financing.title: Flexible Financing Options
financing.description: Evergreen Wireless has partnered with one of North America's largest independent technology and equipment financing companies, to bring Canadian companies financial flexibility and options for purchasing mobile device products and solutions. Our sales team will be able to provide you with an overview of options that minimize risk and maximize your investment.
